title: librarian session error — Kaggle quota-reset research not obtained
what_happened: Dispatched librarian to research Kaggle LLM proxy quota reset cadence; session failed immediately with 'Session too large to compact - context exceeds model limit even after stripping media'. Not retried (known recurring librarian failure in this environment).
root_cause: Pre-existing oversized librarian session context; compaction cannot reduce below model limit. Environmental, not task-related.
impact: Quota-reset cadence research missing. User supplied the answer directly (resets midnight UTC), so no work blocked.
action_taken: Recorded; answer sourced from user instead. Reuse of this session prohibited (errored sessions are not reusable).
